title: Thine Forever, God of Love
description: Thine Forever, God of Love in Tonic Solfa to HEINLEIN, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: Mary Fawler Maude wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 411.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens (7.7.7.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to HEINLEIN; any other Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: Thine for-ev-er, God of Love! Hear us from Thy throne a-bove, Thine for-ev-er may we be Here and in e-ter-ni-ty.

lines: Thine forever, God of Love!
Hear us from Thy throne above,
Thine forever may we be
Here and in eternity.
Thine forever, Lord of Life!
Shield us through our earthly strife;
Thou, the Life, the Truth, the Way,
Guide us to the realms of day.
Thine forever! O how blest
They who find in Thee their rest!
Savior, Guardian, heavenly Friend,
O defend us to the end!
Thine forever! Savior, keep
These Thy frail and trembling sheep!
Safe alone beneath Thy care,
Let us all Thy goodness share.
Thine forever! Thou our Guide,
All our wants by Thee supplied,
All our sins by Thee forgiven;
Lead us, Lord, from earth to heaven.

licence: Public domain: Mary Fawler Maude died in 1913.
credits: Words by Mary Fawler Maude (1819–1913), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to HEINLEIN by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
